Package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog

Class ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.HistoryLog
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog
public class ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog extends HistoryLog
The pump's Control-IQ feature bitmask: the value PumpFeaturesV2Response returns for PumpFeaturesV2Response.SupportedFeatureIndex.CONTROL_IQ_FEATURES, or 0 on firmware that does not support that index. It is fixed by the firmware, not by settings: 0 on t:slim X2 API 2.5 and Mobi 7.6.0.3, 49 on t:slim X2 API 3.2/3.4, 3072 on Mobi 7.7.0.1 and 896 on Mobi 7.9.0.1 and 7.9.0.2. Across 81 records from 8 pumps it matched the live response in every session that captured both, and it changed only at the first boot after a firmware update.

Written at every boot, right after ArmInit and VersionInfo (on the X2, after opcode 312 as well), and in the block the pump writes after every NewDayHistoryLog (VersionsAHistoryLog, opcode 449, opcode 450, this record, DailyStatusHistoryLog): at midnight, after a boot on a new calendar day, after a log erase and after a date change. Older t:slim X2 firmware without PumpFeaturesV2 does not write it.

The class name is provisional: opcode 328 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi app's history log list. Bytes 14-25 have been zero in every record and are exposed raw. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/152.

    • getControlIqFeatures

      public Set<PumpFeaturesV2Response.ControlIqFeatureType> getControlIqFeatures()
      The bits of getControlIqFeaturesBitmask() that pumpX2 has names for. The names come from PumpFeaturesV2Response.ControlIqFeatureType and are not confirmed by this record; bits 4, 5, 7 and 10, which are set on some firmware, have no name and appear only in the raw bitmask.
      Returns:
